name: jacket
description: Jai toolchain: language server, linter, formatter and syntax highlighting for the Jai language

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In an untrusted workspace the language server runs without compile-time execution (no #run, build metaprograms or computed #insert), the Run, Build and Check File commands and the test explorer are off, and workspace settings that name a program, a library directory or compiler arguments are ignored.

semanticTokenTypes.description: A `%` directive in the format string of a call to a procedure declared `@PrintLike`.

jai.server.path.markdownDescription: Path to `jailsp`. Empty: `jailsp` on `PATH`, then next to `#jai.compiler.path#` or the `jaic` on `PATH`, then the downloaded toolchain.

jai.compiler.path.markdownDescription: Path to `jaic`, used by the Run/Build/Check commands. `jailsp`, `jaifmt` and `jailint` are also looked for next to it. Empty: `jaic` on `PATH`, then the downloaded toolchain.

jai.formatter.path.markdownDescription: Path to `jaifmt`. Empty: `jaifmt` on `PATH`, then next to `jaic`, then the downloaded toolchain.

jai.jacket.path.markdownDescription: Path to `jacket`, which runs the tests of the test explorer. Empty: `jacket` on `PATH`, then next to `jaic`, then the downloaded toolchain.

jai.stdlib.path.markdownDescription: Standard library directory, passed to `jailsp` and `jaic` as `JAIC_STDLIB`. Empty: the `stdlib` folder next to the executable.

jai.stdlib.prelude.markdownDescription: Prelude file, passed to `jailsp` and `jaic` as `JAIC_PRELUDE`. Relative paths are relative to the standard library directory; `~` expands to your home directory. Empty: inherit `JAIC_PRELUDE` or detect the prelude.

enumDescriptions: Ask before downloading the toolchain from the GitHub release (once per toolchain version).
Download the pinned toolchain without asking when no jailsp is found.
Never download; show how to install the toolchain instead.
jai.toolchain.autoDownload.markdownDescription: What to do when no `jailsp` is configured or on `PATH`: download the toolchain release whose version matches this extension from github.com/matteopolak/jacket, verified against pinned SHA-256 checksums.

jai.toolchain.preferDownloaded.markdownDescription: Use the toolchain the extension downloaded ahead of `PATH` when `jai.server.path` and `jai.compiler.path` are empty. Set by the warning shown when `PATH` has an older toolchain than this extension expects.

jai.completion.autoImport.markdownDescription: Offer names the file cannot see yet in completion, from standard-library modules, the project's modules and its other files, and add the `#import` or `#load` they need when one is accepted. Project entry files and module folders come from `jacket.toml` (or are inferred).

enumDescriptions: Insert the call's parentheses and leave the cursor inside them (`name($0)`, or `name()` when nothing can be passed).
Insert the parentheses with a placeholder for each parameter a call must pass.
jai.completion.callSnippets.markdownDescription: What accepting a procedure in completion inserts. Parentheses are left out where the procedure is used as a value: before an existing `(`, after `*`, in `type_of(...)`, or in a `::` or global `:=` initialiser. Parameter hints open when the cursor lands inside the parentheses.

jai.inlayHints.closingBraceMinLines.markdownDescription: Show `// name` as an inlay hint after the closing brace of a procedure, struct or enum at least this many lines long. `0` turns it off. Needs `editor.inlayHints.enabled`.

jai.compileTime.evaluationBudget.markdownDescription: Basic blocks one compile-time evaluation (a `#run`, a constant, an `#if` condition...) may run in the editor before it fails at its place and the rest of the program is checked without it. `0` for no limit. Only your user settings count: a workspace cannot raise it.

jai.compileTime.checkTimeLimit.markdownDescription: Seconds a whole check of a program may spend running compile-time code before it stops with partial results and one notice. `0` for no limit. Only your user settings count: a workspace cannot raise it.

jai.compileTime.costLensBlocks.markdownDescription: Show what a compile-time evaluation costs above it when it ran at least this many basic blocks. `Jai: Show Compile-Time Costs` lists them all.

jai.run.arguments.markdownDescription: Extra arguments for the Run, Build and Check File commands, placed after the file and the mode option, such as `-O2`.

jai.tests.codeLens.markdownDescription: Show Run Test and Debug Test above each `@test` procedure.

jai.tests.arguments.markdownDescription: Extra arguments for `jacket test` when the test explorer lists and runs tests, such as `--interp`, or `--`, `-O2` for the compiler.

jai.trace.server.description: Log the messages between VS Code and jailsp to the Jai Language Server output channel.

scripts.build: node scripts/build-grammar.ts && node scripts/build.ts schemas && rolldown -c
scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings && tsc --noEmit -p . && node scripts/build-grammar.ts --check && node scripts/build.ts schemas --check && node scripts/build.ts icon --check
scripts.test: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:grammar
scripts.test:e2e: rolldown -c && pnpm run build:tests && node out/test/e2e/run.cjs
scripts.package: pnpm run build --environment PRODUCTION && node scripts/build.ts license && vsce package --no-dependencies
scripts.screenshots: rolldown -c && pnpm run build:tests && node out/test/screenshots/run.cjs
